# Baseline measurements (phase sase-1t3.13.1.1, HEAD 5b08952c6d)

## Environment (do not infer live-TUI versions from checkout)
- checkout HEAD: 5b08952c6d (plan was written against same HEAD; no drift)
- python: 3.14.7 (venv .venv/bin/python; system python3 is 3.11.13 without textual)
- textual: 8.0.1 (pinned), sase dist 0.19.0, sase import: src/sase/__init__.py (editable checkout)
- sase_core_rs import: .venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/sase_core_rs/__init__.py
- sase-core-revision.txt: 98a22b7906f3bdcc5a9e5c293d975a9ec2c116b5
- host: athena, loadavg ~16-19 at run time, 64 cores, 64GB RAM (Mem avail ~39GB), up 3d
- roster/viewport: headless Pilot (default 80x24); fixture rosters below; cold = first call per agent per process, warm = immediate second call (bench_detail_header_summary definition)
- env flags: SASE_TUI_PERF=1 / SASE_TUI_TRACE=1 via bench fixtures (isolated tmp JSONL paths)

## Reusable commands (all from repo root, .venv python)
- `timeout 540 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_agents.py tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_unread.py tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_keypath.py -q`
- `.venv/bin/python -m tests.perf.bench_detail_header_summary --count 10 --output /tmp/detail_baseline.json`
- `.venv/bin/python -m tests.perf.bench_tui_trace --output /tmp/tui_trace_baseline.json`
- micro-probes (retained in shell history, not committed): /tmp/baseline_probe.py (copy_agent_graph scaling + scan ratio), /tmp/cachekey_probe.py (repr+blake2b hot-read cost)
- retained evidence: /tmp/detail_baseline.json, /tmp/tui_trace_baseline.json

## Results

### post-heap j/k paint (SASE_TUI_PERF key-to-paint; steady-state navigation)
- bench_tui_jk_agents (this run): Agents next p50 6.69ms p95 9.71ms max 10.71ms (n=20); prev p50 8.24ms p95 10.72ms max 12.71ms (n=20). Clan fold levels 1-2 within 16ms p95 (level 3 sample: next p50 7.76 p95 10.12 max 11.19; prev p50 8.24 p95 11.59 max 12.05).
- Verdict: ALREADY SATISFIED for steady-state j/k (p95 < 16ms). Caveat: test_bench_clan_jk_at_each_panel_fold_level FAILED on stall-log assertion (prompt_activity initial event counted as stall), not on paint numbers. Clean-tree failure, recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP below; does not block this phase.

### detail-selection (selection chrome vs 150ms debounce vs lane completion)
- DetailPanelDebouncer = 150ms (src/sase/ace/tui/util/debounce.py); highlight paints immediately, detail deferred by design. Never count debounced completion as key-to-paint.
- bench_detail_header_summary hermetic (count 10): cold p50 memory_reads 470.8ms / artifact_reads 439.5ms / skill_uses 5.7ms; warm p50 memory_reads 3.5ms / artifact_reads 4.3ms / skill_uses 3.4ms. artifact_file_paths ~0.01ms both states (already cached/empty fixture). question_rounds cold max 6.1ms.
- trace view_hints: build_detail_header_summary.bead_touches p50 ~181ms (n=2), memory_reads p50 ~164ms, artifact_reads p50 ~100ms; agents.update_info_panel p50 0.46ms; view_hints_refresh p50 27.6ms.
- header cache key (detail_header_summary_cache_key): repr(summary)+blake2b-16 per hot lookup; micro-probe on ~61KB repr payload: p50 0.214ms p95 0.341ms max 0.357ms. Small per-hit but paid on every hint-render lookup; plan's semantic-token fix stands.
- Verdict: REMAINING. Cold enrichment is 100s of ms (expected off-thread + debounce + cache); warm is single-digit ms. Selection phase work (bounded worker, semantic token, targeted per-agent queries w/ version invalidation) is still justified.

### unread-jump (,u bulk-ack and ,j jump branches)
- ,u: visible p50 37.53 p95 41.83; collapsed_panel p50 24.49 p95 34.96; collapsed_clan p50 42.93 p95 53.54; off_tab p50 32.93 p95 44.53 (n=10 each).
- ,j: visible p50 47.31 p95 56.83; collapsed_panel p50 44.69 p95 109.86; collapsed_clan p50 54.90 p95 127.78; off_tab p50 59.03 p95 132.66 (n=8) + agents_tab_switch 122.78/141.76 (n=2).
- Keypath guard bench passed: no provider discovery/subprocess on keystroke path (only pre-existing off-loop asyncio_3 git/gh/npm/rev-parse noted as rule-1 compliant).
- Verdict: REMAINING as regression surface (preserve immediate-selection + deferred-detail + target-panel-only expansion; fix only regressions new measurements identify). Numbers are navigation+expansion operations, not j/k paint; no 16ms budget claimed.

### runtime-tick (periodic work)
- Code: AgentList.patch_active_runtime_rows loops whole self._agents (widgets/_agent_list_widget.py:363); _bead_warmup_candidates walks self._agents (actions/agents/_loading_bead_warmup.py:256). Confirms plan's claim.
- Trace full-baseline: refresh.auto_tick p50 ~1960ms p95 ~4497ms max ~4497ms (n=6); axe.collect p50 ~481ms p95 ~2328ms. Tick path is seconds-scale in the synthetic fixture and must stay viewport-bounded.
- Micro-probe predicate scan: full vs viewport(30): n=150 ratio 4.1x, n=600 ratio 16.3x (absolute µs-scale for cheap predicate; real resolver/aggregate calls dominate).
- Verdict: REMAINING. Viewport-aware row selection + waiter-set bounding still justified; preserve Rust interval-union semantics and cache bounds.

### exact-delta-copy (graph preparation ownership)
- Code: own_required_apply_snapshot -> copy_agent_graph on required roots (_loading_graph.py:108); _loading_compute_merge.py normalizes relationships after merge (deleting the copy would race live UI).
- Micro-probe: copy_agent_graph full detach p50 31.6ms@150 / 126.6ms@600 (scales with roster, not delta). copy_agent_rows_relinked p50 1.6ms@150 / 7.8ms@600. Affected-closure subset copy (clan + k rows) still p50 ~31ms@150 / ~126ms@600 because clan.runtime_children fans out to all rows through the shared memo — the naive closure copy does NOT bound cost. This is the strongest evidence for the plan's conservative exact-delta path: ownership must not copy container fan-out, only genuinely mutated rows + relationship closure, with explicit trace-reason fallback.
- Which passes mutate: relationship normalization (_loading_compute_merge), slot annotation / named-proc carryover / fold-fleet projection / finalization (per plan; verified by code read, not re-timed here).
- Verdict: REMAINING.

### bead-warmup (bead display coalescing)
- Code: _bead_warmup_candidates already coalesces off-pump and patches by identity, but collection still walks self._agents and stranded-project collection walks _agents_with_children; scheduling probes candidates before coalescing checks and worker probes again (matches plan).
- Scaling: same scan-ratio probe as ticks (4x@150, 16x@600 for predicate-only scan); real warm_* resolver calls dominate and must be bounded to surfaced rows + separately-maintained WAITING waiter set.
- Verdict: REMAINING.

## Already-satisfied vs remaining summary
- already satisfied: post-heap steady-state j/k paint (p95 < 16ms on measured branches).
- remaining: detail-selection, unread-jump (regression surface), runtime-tick, exact-delta-copy, bead-warmup.
- no new general telemetry subsystem added (per plan constraint); reused existing benches + two /tmp micro-probes.

## Changed paths
- None. Measurement-only phase; no repo files modified (git status clean).

## Verification this turn
- bench_tui_jk_agents/unread/keypath: 3 passed (unread+keypath run), 1 passed + 1 failed (agents run; failure is stall-log assertion only, paint in budget).
- bench_detail_header_summary hermetic count 10: pass, JSON retained.
- bench_tui_trace full: pass, JSON retained.
- No `just check` (no tracked files changed; lint_and_test gate not triggered).

## PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: clan fold bench stall-log assertion trips on prompt_activity initial event
Clean-tree `test_bench_clan_jk_at_each_panel_fold_level` fails at the final stall-log gate (`prompt_activity transition=initial` counted as actual stall) while all paint p95s stay < 16ms. Either the test's actual-stall filter must exclude the initial prompt_activity event or the watchdog must not log it as a stall row. Evidence: this baseline run (HEAD 5b08952c6d), `pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_agents.py`.

Baseline captured: env (HEAD 5b08952c6d, py3.14.7, textual 8.0.1, core 98a22b7) and j/k p50/p95/max, comma-j branches, cold/warm header lanes, delta-copy scaling, tick/warmup scan ratios recorded in bead note; j/k already satisfied, 5 lanes remain with evidence; clan-fold stall-gate clean-tree failure recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP

# Combined integration verification — 2026-11-18

## Environment and fixture

- Checkout HEAD: `194b1a1ef4175fe5397b8f666883ac9028cbcec3`; working tree clean; no tracked paths changed.
- Python 3.14.7 from `.venv/bin/python`; Textual 8.0.1 from `.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/textual/__init__.py`; sase 0.19.0 imported from `src/sase/__init__.py`; `sase_core_rs` 0.44.2 imported from `.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/sase_core_rs/__init__.py`.
- `sase-core-revision.txt` and linked `sase-core` HEAD both equal `b1a0363997eb8150f8db8a425b83564faf5101f3`. The baseline used the same Python/Textual/sase versions but core revision `98a22b7906f3bdcc5a9e5c293d975a9ec2c116b5`; cold comparisons are therefore directional.
- Host: athena, Linux 6.12.117, 64 CPUs, 62.7 GiB total and 28.9 GiB available after the run. At the first bench, load averages were 19.30/16.90/13.37; at the isolated repeat they were 6.37/9.68/12.90. Baseline recorded load about 16–19 and about 39 GB available.
- Headless Pilot defaults to 80x24. Detail benchmark used count=10 (first call cold, immediate second call warm). Full trace fixtures were 100 CS/50 agents, 500/200, and 2000/1000.

## Commands and results

1. `timeout 540 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_agents.py tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_unread.py tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_keypath.py -q`
2. `.venv/bin/python -m tests.perf.bench_detail_header_summary --count 10 --output /tmp/detail_combined.json`
3. `.venv/bin/python -m tests.perf.bench_tui_trace --output /tmp/tui_trace_combined.json`
4. Focused combined suite (worker/enrichment, two-phase/deferred detail, bead warmup, runtime patch/tick/compute, artifact-delta loader, delta-copy, graph isolation/merge, unread fast path): 212 passed in 9.70s.
5. Isolated diagnostic repeat: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_agents.py -k 'test_bench_agents_jk_and_panel_navigation or test_bench_selected_tribe_jk_at_each_fold_level' -q`.

### Agents j/k and fold levels

Primary-run `next` was p50/p95/max 16.21/37.11/83.59 ms (n=19), `prev` 13.63/40.36/48.07 ms (n=19); panel cycling `next_agent_panel` 37.51/45.76/47.76 ms (n=20) and `prev_agent_panel` 54.96/65.24/70.43 ms (n=20). Baseline `next` was 6.69/9.71/10.71 ms (n=20), `prev` 8.24/10.72/12.71 ms (n=20). The ordinary j/k p95 target is missed in this combined-tree run.

Clan fold levels remained below the 16 ms p95 target (each direction n=20):

- Level 1 next 7.60/12.24/12.91 ms; prev 8.79/11.78/12.24 ms.
- Level 2 next 8.18/13.76/27.47 ms; prev 8.35/10.67/12.45 ms.
- Level 3 next 9.26/14.32/25.62 ms; prev 7.20/10.57/10.85 ms.

The new selected-tribe fold case stopped at level 1 because its 40 ms p95 guard failed: next 52.97/80.99/96.21 ms and prev 52.94/71.64/98.72 ms (n=40 each). The lower-load isolated repeat still failed: next 46.53/64.58/68.01 ms and prev 44.99/58.49/65.19 ms. Its remaining fold levels were not reached. This is a persistent miss on the combined tree; it was not clean-base compared.

The same isolated repeat measured ordinary next 15.92/20.25/61.30 ms (n=19) and prev 13.66/17.98/18.28 ms (n=19), confirming p95 remains above the 16 ms target. The baseline note's known clan-fold failure is separate: the fold p95 values pass, but the final stall-log assertion treats `prompt_activity transition=initial` as an actual stall. That failure was already reproduced on the clean baseline and recorded on `sase-1t3.13.1.1` and its parent note.

### Unread navigation and keypath

Current comma-j p50/p95/max: visible 49.97/70.17/70.17 ms (n=10); collapsed panel 47.95/96.26/96.26 (n=10); collapsed clan 57.07/140.77/140.77 (n=10); off-tab 54.42/140.78/140.78 (n=8); tab switch 133.64/140.13/140.13 (n=2). Baseline p50/p95 was 47.31/56.83, 44.69/109.86, 54.90/127.78, 59.03/132.66, and 122.78/141.76 respectively. These are navigation/expansion operations, not j/k paint.

The keypath guard passed. It observed `git describe`, `gh api`, `npm root`, and `git rev-parse` only on asyncio worker threads, outside the keystroke path. The unread bulk-ack branches also passed (n=10 per branch).

### Detail chrome, debounce, and lane completion

In the count-10 hermetic detail run, cold/warm p50 and max were: memory reads 478.4/530.9 ms and 3.4/3.9 ms; artifact reads 443.0/460.7 ms and 4.2/8.4 ms; skill uses 5.8/272.5 ms and 3.7/3.8 ms. Baseline p50s were 470.8/3.5 ms for memory reads, 439.5/4.3 ms for artifact reads, and 5.7/3.4 ms for skill uses. The benchmark reports p50/max, not p95; each cold/warm lane used 10 agents. `/tmp/detail_combined.json` retains the report.

The immediate detail-panel chrome span `agents.update_info_panel` was 1.23/17.44/17.54 ms (p50/p95/max, n=20) on the 2000/1000 fixture; the immediate highlight span stayed below 0.5 ms p95. The intentional 150 ms detail debounce remains in place. The `agents.refresh_debounced` span measures the handler after that delay, not the wait: at 2000/1000 it was 43.92/70.05/70.05 ms (n=2). Header lane completion is separate: `build_detail_header_summary` was 1323.52/3680.92/3680.92 ms (n=4) in that fixture; on the clan-container hint scenario it was 351.57/476.40/476.40 ms (n=3), with both cold and warm results represented. The slow-enrichment A/B/A regression test passed.

### Runtime, warmup, graph isolation, and memory behavior

Full-trace `refresh.auto_tick` p50/p95/max was 577.55/879.99/879.99 ms (n=4) at 100/50, 771.15/1506.22/1506.22 (n=4) at 500/200, and 1939.12/2347.06/2347.06 (n=4) at 2000/1000. At 2000/1000 the baseline note reports about 1960/4497/4497 ms (n=6): current p50 is similar, p95/max lower, with fewer samples. `axe.collect` at 2000/1000 was 594.27/1837.27/1837.27 ms (n=5), against baseline about 481/2328 ms. Trace warmup spans were 3221 ms (n=1) at 100/50, 690.80/1190.07 ms (n=2) at 500/200, and 3963 ms (n=1) at 2000/1000. The trace also logged an unhandled Textual timer `ZeroDivisionError` with interval zero; the command still exited 0 and wrote its complete JSON.

The focused tests verify the resource bounds: rapid A/B/A selection kept one compute active, replaced the pending request with the latest selection, skipped B, and kept one reusable cached result; runtime patching touched only surfaced viewport rows (2 of 40 in the 8-line viewport fixture); warmup selected at most 32 of 80 historical WAITING rows per batch, covered 64 distinct rows across two batches, and kept stranded projects to at most 4 per batch. The small-delta probe used 150- and 600-row graphs with 2- and 8-row updates. Deep graph-copy rows/calls were zero, but shallow Agent copies were 150/150/600/600, while only 2/8/2/8 changed rows remained new after share-back. Thus retained rows are delta-sized, but temporary allocation still scales with the full roster. This is a measured copy/memory target miss for follow-up.

The trace harness does not report process RSS or heap heartbeats, so this run makes no long-session heap claim; the separate soak phase owns that measurement. Available host memory was 28.9 GiB at the end. No tracked source files changed, so no repo-wide check was required.

Repeated combined interaction measurements and focused verification; 212 tests passed; benchmark results, environment, baseline comparisons, and remaining misses recorded on this phase and parent; epic-symbols empty.
